questions.title: Question ledger gate
questions.empty: no questions collected — empty input is not a pass (zero-value guard): check the questions/ directory first
questions.missing_settling: %(name)s: missing `**Settling:**` line — a question without an executable settler is only a guess
questions.none_without_first_deliverable: %(name)s: Settling says "does not exist" but does not state that **it is the first deliverable** — otherwise the reader does not know the next step
questions.no_distinct_outcomes: %(name)s: Settling gives no **two distinguishable outcomes** (write `… — rc=0 ⇒ A; rc=7 ⇒ B`) — describing only the procedure proves nothing
questions.settler_missing: %(name)s: the settler Settling points at **does not exist**: %(target)s
questions.guard_empty: question files (%(count)d of them) are empty
questions.ok: Question ledger gate: OK (%(count)d questions, %(open)d still open)
